plan.title: Unwrap npm 12 npm view --json single-element arrays in installer registry resolution

narratives.Description: On npm 12, `npm view --json` returns a single-element array for version and metadata queries. Directive's registry helpers reject that shape, so install and upgrade fail without an explicit target version.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Update packages/cli/src/registry.ts so resolveLatestStableVersion and related metadata parsers unwrap a single-element array while still rejecting true multi-value surprises.
2. Extend focused installer/registry tests (install-bookend / upgrade-bookend coverage) to assert npm-12 array fixtures succeed and multi-value payloads still fail closed.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer on npm 12, I want directive install and upgrade to resolve the latest stable version from the registry, so that I can install without inventing a target version.

narrative.Acceptance: Given npm view --json returns a one-element array for a version string, when resolveLatestStableVersion runs, then it returns that version string.

items.title: Reject true multi-value npm view arrays

narrative.Acceptance: Given npm view --json returns a multi-element array, when registry resolution runs, then it fails closed with a clear parse error and does not pick an arbitrary element.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/cli/src/install-bookend.test.ts packages/cli/src/upgrade-bookend.test.ts
expected_outputs: Focused registry/bookend tests pass for npm-12 array unwrap and multi-value reject
